parts.name: frame shell

physics.Basic_description: Dark grey painted metal frame forming the handle and barrel support structure.
physics.Functional_description: Provides the structural backbone and handle for the tool, supporting the cartridge and trigger mechanism.
physics.Grasped_description: Grasp the handle or the side rails of the frame to hold the tool steady.
physics.reason: Stamped sheet metal construction typical for caulking gun frames, enclosing air.

parts.description: Dark grey painted metal frame forming the handle and barrel support structure.
parts.function: Provides the structural backbone and handle for the tool, supporting the cartridge and trigger mechanism.

parts.name: pivot pin

physics.Basic_description: Small metallic pin located at the trigger pivot point.
physics.Functional_description: Acts as the axle for the trigger mechanism to rotate around.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and internal to be grasped directly.
physics.reason: Pins are typically solid metal rods to withstand shear forces.

parts.description: Small metallic pin located at the trigger pivot point.
parts.function: Acts as the axle for the trigger mechanism to rotate around.

parts.name: rib rod 0

physics.Basic_description: Thin metal rods running along the length of the frame barrel.
physics.Functional_description: Guide the plunger rod and provide structural rigidity to the frame.
physics.Grasped_description: Not intended for grasping; too thin and obstructed by the cartridge.
physics.reason: Structural rods are solid metal wire or round stock.

parts.name: cartridge body

physics.Basic_description: Blue cylindrical plastic tube containing the sealant material.
physics.Functional_description: Holds the viscous sealant and transfers pressure from the plunger to the nozzle.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be grasped around the circumference to stabilize or remove the cartridge.
physics.reason: Standard caulking cartridges are thin-walled plastic tubes filled with paste (modeled as hollow shell for mass estimation of the container itself).

parts.description: Blue cylindrical plastic tube containing the sealant material.
parts.function: Holds the viscous sealant and transfers pressure from the plunger to the nozzle.

parts.name: front collar

physics.Basic_description: Dark grey metal ring at the front of the barrel holding the cartridge.
physics.Functional_description: Secures the front of the cartridge and aligns the nozzle.
physics.Grasped_description: Not a primary grasp point; too small and close to the nozzle.
physics.reason: Stamped metal ring component, hollow center for cartridge passage.

parts.description: Dark grey metal ring at the front of the barrel holding the cartridge.
parts.function: Secures the front of the cartridge and aligns the nozzle.

parts.name: nozzle

physics.Basic_description: White conical plastic tip attached to the front of the cartridge.
physics.Functional_description: Directs the flow of sealant and allows cutting to specific bead sizes.
physics.Grasped_description: Too small and fragile to grasp for manipulation of the whole object.
physics.reason: Injection molded plastic cone with a hollow channel for material flow.

parts.description: White conical plastic tip attached to the front of the cartridge.
parts.function: Directs the flow of sealant and allows cutting to specific bead sizes.

parts.name: trigger blade

physics.Basic_description: Dark grey metal lever located inside the handle grip area.
physics.Functional_description: Squeezed by the user to advance the plunger rod and dispense sealant.
physics.Grasped_description: The primary actuation point; a gripper would press this against the handle.
physics.reason: Stamped sheet metal part, likely formed into a channel shape for stiffness.

parts.description: Dark grey metal lever located inside the handle grip area.
parts.function: Squeezed by the user to advance the plunger rod and dispense sealant.

parts.name: plunger rod

physics.Basic_description: Silver metallic rod with a T-handle extending from the rear of the gun.
physics.Functional_description: Pushes the internal piston of the cartridge to extrude the sealant.
physics.Grasped_description: Can be grasped by the T-handle or shaft to manually retract or position the plunger.
physics.reason: Plunger rods are typically solid metal or thick-walled extrusions acting as solid columns under compression.

parts.description: Silver metallic rod with a T-handle extending from the rear of the gun.
parts.function: Pushes the internal piston of the cartridge to extrude the sealant.

simulation.collision: CoACD convex decomposition of concave source collision meshes (relative tolerance 0.03–0.05)
simulation.inertia: Source URDF link inertials; missing inertials use geometry-derived defaults (density 1000 kg/m³)
simulation.friction: Source URDF mu1 as sliding friction; torsional 0.005, rolling 0.0001
simulation.contact: MuJoCo soft contacts (solref 0.01 1); source restitution is displayed, not converted
simulation.material: Rigid bodies; Young’s modulus and Poisson ratio are annotations, not soft-body parameters

interaction.description: Switchable virtual joint damping and reflected armature for interactive inspection; source properties are unchanged.
interaction.rule: damping ≥ rated effort / rated speed; armature = 2% child subtree mass (slide) or 2% mass × collision radius² (hinge)

collisionFilter.description: Self-contact excluded between directly connected rigid groups, including the fixed base; nonadjacent contacts retained
